strings.{combo} 已被「{label}」使用，请换一个组合键: {combo} is already used by “{label}” — pick another combo
strings.⋯ 已折叠 {n} 行相同 — 点击展开: ⋯ {n} identical lines collapsed — click to expand
strings.与「{name}」比较 — 选择另一侧文件: Compare with “{name}” — pick the other file
strings.主密钥用于加密保存的服务器密码。未设置主密钥时，记住的密码以明文保存在本机配置中: The master key encrypts saved server passwords. Without it, remembered passwords are stored in plain text in the local config; once set,
strings.主机、用户名、分组等配置保留。: Hosts, usernames, groups and other settings are kept.
strings.仅比对文件夹与文件名: Compare folders and file names only
strings.以右侧为准覆盖左侧？: Overwrite the left side with the right?
strings.以右侧为准，同步到左侧（覆盖/删除左侧差异）: Right wins; sync to the left (overwrite/delete left-side diffs)
strings.以左侧为准覆盖右侧？: Overwrite the right side with the left?
strings.以左侧为准，同步到右侧（覆盖/删除右侧差异）: Left wins; sync to the right (overwrite/delete right-side diffs)
strings.修改时间差在此容差内视为相同（跨文件系统精度差异）: mtime differences within this tolerance count as equal (cross-filesystem precision)
strings.允许接收方上溯到父目录: Allow receivers to browse parent folders
strings.允许接收方上溯到父目录（仅浏览）: Allow receivers to browse parent folders (read-only)
strings.入口：右键标签页「收藏此标签页」、空白处右键「收藏夹…」、快捷键: Entry points: right-click a tab “Favorite this tab”, blank-area right-click “Favorites…”, shortcut
strings.关闭将丢弃两侧未保存的编辑。: Closing discards unsaved edits on both sides.
strings.内置插件按统一契约登记（协议前缀 + 操作集 + 启用开关）。禁用后对应入口隐藏: Built-in plugins register against a unified contract (protocol prefix + operations + enable switch). Disabling hides their entries and rejects routes; future external plugins (e.g. http-autoindex) join via the same registry.
strings.分享为链接时的默认行为：是否允许接收方上溯父目录（默认关闭，严格锁定分享根内）、: Defaults when sharing as a link: whether receivers may browse parent folders (off by default, strictly locked inside the share root) and the default expiry.
strings.切换编码会按新编码重新读取并比较两侧文件，未保存的编辑（含已应用的补丁）将被丢弃: Switching re-reads and re-compares both files with the new encoding; unsaved edits (including applied patches) will be discarded.
strings.删除临时目录中的全部文件: Delete all files in the temp folder
strings.双击在对应窗格定位: Double-click to locate in the pane
strings.只保存配置，不发起连接: Save the config only; do not connect
strings.只存在内存中、不会写入磁盘: lives only in memory and is never written to disk
strings.可选，用于侧边栏分组管理: Optional; groups servers in the sidebar
strings.可选，默认远程家目录: Optional; defaults to the remote home
strings.右侧的当前内容（含已应用的补丁与未保存编辑）将被整份替换为左侧内容；替换后需点「: The right side's current content (including applied patches and unsaved edits) will be fully replaced with the left side's content; click “Save changes” to write the file, or “Discard changes” to revert.
strings.右键菜单第一行按此顺序横排显示（最多 10 个）：点图标直接用该工具打开当前目录: Shown in this order as the context menu's first row (up to 10): click an icon to open the current folder (as a workspace) or file with that tool. Independent of “Open with” extension associations.
strings.同名文件再比对 hash 与修改时间: Same-name files also compared by hash and mtime
strings.同名文件再比对内容大小: Same-name files also compared by size
strings.名称匹配不区分大小写（点击改为区分）: Name matching ignores case (click to make case-sensitive)
strings.名称匹配区分大小写（点击改为不区分）: Name matching is case-sensitive (click to ignore case)
strings.图文浏览模式：在图片/文档为主的目录进入沉浸浏览（中央大图 + 底部缩略图条）。: Image & text browse: enter immersive browsing in image/document-heavy folders (large center image + thumbnail strip).
strings.如 json, yaml（逗号/空格分隔，回车添加）: e.g. json, yaml (comma/space separated, Enter to add)
strings.存在解码有损的一侧，已禁编辑；仅无损侧可保存: A side decoded lossily and is read-only; only lossless sides can be saved
strings.将移入回收站，可随时按 Ctrl+Z 撤销恢复。: Items move to the trash; undo with Ctrl+Z anytime.
strings.左侧的当前内容（含已应用的补丁与未保存编辑）将被整份替换为右侧内容；替换后需点「: The left side's current content (including applied patches and unsaved edits) will be fully replaced with the right side's content; click “Save changes” to write the file, or “Discard changes” to revert.
strings.左侧选择一个窗格: Pick a pane on the left
strings.差异过大，已按整块替换粗略显示（未做行级对齐）: Diff too large; shown as coarse block replacements (no line alignment)
strings.应用到右侧：此差异块以左侧为准（右侧记为未保存）: Apply to right: this hunk takes the left side (right marked unsaved)
strings.应用到左侧：此差异块以右侧为准（左侧记为未保存）: Apply to left: this hunk takes the right side (left marked unsaved)
strings.开启后右侧滑出预览栏（悬浮拉门，不挤压布局；全应用共用，跟随焦点窗格的选中项），: When on, a preview panel slides out on the right (floating drawer, no layout squeeze; shared app-wide, follows the focused pane's selection); clicking a file does not preview directly; images/text/PDF/Office are previewable, other types show an info card.
strings.或直接输入文件路径（支持本地 / sftp:// / http(s)://）…: Or type a file path directly (local / sftp:// / http(s)://)…
strings.把编辑写入左侧/右侧文件（SFTP 侧自动回传覆盖）: Write edits to the left/right files (SFTP side is written back automatically)
strings.拖动调整左右栏宽度: Drag to resize the two panes
strings.搜索命令…（↑↓ 选择，回车执行）: Search commands… (↑↓ to select, Enter to run)
strings.收藏 = 单个标签页的命名布局快照：全部窗格路径、分屏结构、视图/缩放状态。打开: A favorite is a named snapshot of one tab's layout: all pane paths, split structure, view/zoom state. Opening a favorite restores it in a new tab (local paths load directly; SFTP panes reconnect automatically). Independent of the whole-session “save and exit”.
strings.改回默认（系统临时目录下 r-dir-remote）: Back to default (r-dir-remote under the system temp folder)
strings.整份以右侧为准覆盖左侧（左侧记为未保存，可继续编辑或保存）: Adopt the whole right side over the left (left marked unsaved; keep editing or save)
strings.整份以左侧为准覆盖右侧（右侧记为未保存，可继续编辑或保存）: Adopt the whole left side over the right (right marked unsaved; keep editing or save)
strings.整体缩放，作用于整个界面；默认 13px，与窗口内 Ctrl+滚轮缩放相互叠加（: Global scaling applied to the whole UI; defaults to 13px and multiplies with in-window Ctrl+wheel zoom (e.g. 80% font × 130% window = 104%).
strings.文件按 {enc} 解码存在无效字节（可能选错了编码），已按替换符显示；此侧禁止: The file has invalid bytes when decoded as {enc} (possibly the wrong encoding); shown with replacement characters. This side is read-only to avoid writing them back
strings.无匹配文件（仅列出该窗格当前目录的文件）: No matching files (listing the pane's current folder only)
strings.暂无活跃分享。右键文件夹或点「新建分享」把目录分享为链接。: No active shares. Right-click a folder or click “New share” to share a folder as a link.
strings.服务器将无法自动连接，需要重新输入密码。: servers will no longer auto-connect; re-enter passwords.
strings.未关联任何类型（不会出现在右键）: No associated types (won't appear in the context menu)
strings.未注册打开方式，可点击下方“选择其他应用…”添加: No openers registered — add one via “Choose another app…” below
strings.未识别出 diff 内容（需要 unified diff 格式：git diff: Unrecognized diff content (unified diff required: git diff output or a .patch file)
strings.未识别出 diff 内容：需要 unified diff 格式（@@ 开头的 h: Unrecognized diff content: unified diff format required (@@ hunks), e.g. output of `git diff`
strings.检测到本机已安装（点击一键加入）：: Detected on this machine (click to add):
strings.正在为「{label}」录制新键位 —— 请按下组合键（Esc 取消）: Recording a new shortcut for “{label}” — press the combo (Esc to cancel)
strings.每个打开方式只对已关联的扩展名生效（* 表示所有类型）。右键文件 → 打开方式: Each opener applies only to its associated extensions (* = all types). Right-click a file → Open with → Choose another app… associates that file's extension automatically.
strings.没有可用窗格（各窗格当前目录都没有文件）: No usable panes (no files in any pane's current folder)
strings.点击每行右侧的“录制”可自定义当前平台键位（{platform}）；带 ● 的为: Click “Record” on a row to customize keys for this platform ({platform}); rows with ● are customized — click “×” to reset.
strings.版本号取自应用元数据（tauri.conf.json），随发布 tag 同步。: The version comes from app metadata (tauri.conf.json), synced with release tags.
strings.现有的明文密码会立即自动加密: existing plain-text passwords are encrypted immediately
strings.留空 = 永久（直到关闭客户端或主动停止分享）。: Empty = forever (until the client closes or the share is stopped).
strings.留空 = 默认：终端类（Git Bash / cmd / PowerShell: Empty = default: terminal-type tools (Git Bash / cmd / PowerShell / bash…) open a window in the current folder, others open with the path as argument;
strings.的服务器不受影响（私钥在文件系统）。: servers are unaffected (private keys live on the filesystem).
strings.目标已存在同名项目: An item with the same name already exists
strings.行高亮：红 = 左侧（删除），绿 = 右侧（新增）: Row highlight: red = left (deleted), green = right (added)
strings.· 悬停行号可编辑/插入/删除，双击单元格编辑，中轴按钮可按块应用一侧，或用「采: · Hover the gutter to edit/insert/delete, double-click a cell to edit, axis buttons apply a hunk, or use “Adopt left/right” to transfer a whole side; drag the axis to resize
strings.丢弃未保存的编辑，重新从磁盘读取: Discard unsaved edits and re-read from disk
strings.两侧的编辑（含已应用的补丁）将被丢弃，重新从磁盘读取。: Edits on both sides (including applied patches) will be discarded and re-read from disk.
strings.两侧行尾格式不同：左 {l} · 右 {r}。行级比对已按归一化换行处理，此差异: Line endings differ: left {l} · right {r}. Row comparison already normalizes newlines; this difference is not shown in the row diff
strings.记住口令（主密钥加密后保存到配置目录）: Remember passphrase (encrypted with master key into the config folder)
strings.记住密码（主密钥加密后保存到配置目录）: Remember password (encrypted with master key into the config folder)
strings.访问者 IP 可在状态栏「分享」面板查看；关闭被分享的窗口/标签或到期即自动停止: Visitor IPs are visible in the status bar “Share” panel; sharing stops automatically when the shared window/tab closes or on expiry.
strings.读取剪贴板失败（可在文本框中 Ctrl+V 粘贴）: Failed to read clipboard (paste with Ctrl+V in the box)
strings.路径是目录，请选择文件: Path is a folder — pick a file
strings.输入主密钥解锁已保存的服务器密码（AES-256-GCM）。: Enter the master key to unlock saved server passwords (AES-256-GCM).
strings.输入字体名，如 Consolas: Type a font name, e.g. Consolas
strings.输出或 patch 内容（支持多文件），解析后左右对照显示。: output or patch content (multiple files supported), shown side by side after parsing.
strings.还没有常用工具。点右上角「添加」选择应用，或从下方检测列表一键加入。: No quick tools yet. Click “Add” top-right to pick an app, or add from the detected list below.
strings.还没有自定义打开方式。右键文件 → 打开方式 → 选择其他应用… 添加。: No custom openers yet. Right-click a file → Open with → Choose another app… to add one.
strings.远程文件（SFTP / HTTP 等）通过「打开」或「打开方式」交给外部应用前，: Remote files (SFTP / HTTP etc.) are downloaded here before being handed to external apps via “Open”/“Open with”; cleaning removes only local copies, never the remote originals. Changing the folder does not migrate old files — clean the old one before switching.
strings.选择其他目录作为远程临时目录: Pick another folder as the remote temp folder
strings.选择编码后，左右两侧同时按该编码重新解码并比较: After choosing an encoding, both sides re-decode and re-compare with it
strings.链接即凭证，请勿外泄: The link is the credential — do not share it
strings.需要设置/输入主密钥以解密保存的密码: Set/enter the master key to decrypt the saved password
strings.非终端工具的参数里没写占位符时，路径自动补在末尾。: for non-terminal tools without a placeholder in the arguments, the path is appended automatically.
strings.验证通过后将自动重新连接未完成的远程目录；取消则保持当前布局、不连接。: After verification, unfinished remote folders reconnect automatically; cancelling keeps the current layout without connecting.
strings.默认关闭：对方被锁定在分享根内；开启后父目录及以上仅可浏览（不可写）。: Off by default: receivers are locked inside the share root; when on, parent folders are browse-only (no writes).
strings.（当前目录或所选文件完整路径）、: (full path of the current folder or selected file),
strings.，之后连接需输入主密钥解锁。: and connecting requires the master key to unlock.
strings.；应用不关闭则无需重复输入。: ; no re-entry needed while the app runs.
